get-env._note: observed shape is a dict[str, str] of ~32 npm/shell env vars specific to the probing machine (NODE, PATH, HOME, npm_config_*, ...). Field names are not stable across environments (CI, other machines), so no TypedDict was minted — return stays Any to avoid overfitting to one probe's env.

get-resource-links._note: tool returns MCP resource_link content blocks; McpCaller reduces the response to its text summary only ('Here are 3 resource links...'), the structured link objects are invisible to probe. Return stays Any.

get-resource-reference._note: returns an embedded MCP resource (Text or Blob); McpCaller surfaces only the text envelope, structured resource content (uri, mimeType, blob/text data) is not visible to probe. Return stays Any.

get-tiny-image._note: returns an MCP image content block (base64 + mimeType); McpCaller surfaces only accompanying text ('Here's the image you requested:'), the binary payload is invisible to probe. Return stays Any per image/binary guidance.

gzip-file-as-resource._note: outputType='resourceLink' yields a short text summary; outputType='resource' yields an embedded binary resource (gzip blob) with no accompanying text at all, so probe observed an empty string for that variant. Content is not modelable from text-only probing. Return stays Any.
